brief.headline: Our ₹7775 annual spend is tiny — lock faster payment (30 to 15 days) for a 5–10% price cut and qualify Huhtamaki or Constantia as a second source.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a 5–10% price cut on laminates in exchange for faster payment and stable volume.
priceAsk.target: Target the middle of the market fair band — around ₹250/kg — to protect margin without straining their business.
priceAsk.basis: The market ask for pharma / ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, with ₹250/kg typical; the verdict is MARKET-FAIR (top of fair band), meaning our current price sits at the high end of what's reasonable — room exists to negotiate down toward the middle.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days to 15 days after receipt — pay them faster in exchange for the price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: This would free up ₹320 in cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financial statements, so we can't see their revenue, profit or debt — the plan must lean on our own purchase data and on lining up a second source. Our ₹7775 annual spend is very small, so we have almost no volume leverage. That means we can't squeeze hard, but we can use the threat of splitting volume with Huhtamaki or Constantia to win a fair deal: faster payment (15 days instead of 30) in exchange for a modest price cut. Because we're tiny to them, they may prefer to keep us happy and paid-up rather than risk losing even this small, stable order.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with Silk Polypack is very small
We currently pay 30 days after receipt
Moving to 15 days would free up cash for us
The market asking price for pharma / ORS sachet laminate sits in a fair band
Typical market price is in the middle of that band
Our current price position is at the top of the fair band

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter (already a tiny FDC supplier) — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets; health C (59/100), revenue ₹2758.00 Cr.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter — pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source for GEEP; health D (31/100), revenue ₹222.04 Cr.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source at scale; health C (46/100), revenue ₹16492.00 Cr.

risks: Our ₹7775 spend is tiny — we have almost no volume leverage, so a hard push could simply lose us the supplier.
Silk Polypack's financials aren't public, so we can't gauge their cash position or ability to absorb a price cut — tread carefully.
The market ask verdict is 'top of fair band' — our price is high but not outrageous, so the room for a cut is modest (5–10% is realistic, not 20%).
If we split volume to Huhtamaki or Constantia without a firm RFQ and audit, we risk quality or delivery surprises — qualify any alternate before committing.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move you to 15-day payment and lock stable volume — in return, we need your laminate price to come down 5–10% to sit in the middle of the market band at around ₹250/kg.
